headline: Indian Real Estate Deal Value Plunges 69% in Q3 to $705M
summary: Deal value in the Indian real estate sector dropped 69% quarter-over-quarter to $705 million during July-September, affected by global macroeconomic uncertainty.
why: Institutional property investment reflects domestic asset liquidity and foreign direct investment appetite in India.

impacts.name: Real Estate
impacts.why: Sharp contraction in institutional transaction volume dampens developer financing and liquidity.
